title: Variables, Single Assignment & The = Pattern Match Operator
solutionExplanation: Demonstrates single assignment immutability using sequential variables and tuple pattern extraction.

otpDocCards.description: Binds unbound variables or asserts term equivalence.
otpDocCards.complexityNote: O(1) memory pointer binding or structural term comparison.

mentalModelCheck.question: What happens if you execute: X = 5, X = X + 1 in an Erlang shell?

options.label: X becomes 6 because the latest assignment overwrites the previous value
options.explanation: Erlang variables are strictly single-assignment and cannot be overwritten.

options.label: The runtime throws a {badmatch, 6} exception because 5 cannot match 6
options.explanation: X is already bound to 5. Evaluating X = X + 1 attempts to assert 5 = 6, which fails.

options.label: The compiler converts X into an integer pointer and increments the memory address
options.explanation: Erlang does not expose memory pointers; terms are immutable values.
